trace.cypher:
MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (t)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City)
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
WITH t, c, collect(o.name) AS owner_names
WHERE (CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) > 1989 AND NOT 'Gabe Plotkin and Rick Schnall' IN owner_names)
   OR (CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) = 1967 AND 'Atlanta Spirit LLC' IN owner_names)
RETURN DISTINCT c.city_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
